thesis: AI may structure and prepare evidence, but evidence integrity, source metadata and external legal actions remain independently inspectable and human-controlled.

evidence.claim: SafeVoice does not determine guilt, provide qualified legal advice or autonomously file consequential actions.
The agent runtime uses explicit tools and bounded iteration, but a portable capability-policy contract is not yet published.
The public prototype does not publish production multi-tenant isolation evidence.
An approval checkpoint is required before external action.
Evidence receives SHA-256 hashes, timestamps, source metadata and browser-side integrity verification.
Evidence and case outputs are bounded, but a dedicated exfiltration/protected-scope adversarial contract is not yet published.
The agent runtime has explicit tools, iteration limits and audit records.
Evidence hashes/source metadata and bounded agent audit records support inspectable review.
No complete SBOM, signing or third-party supply-chain assurance claim is published.
The existing 35-case evaluation corpus measures classification/legal-grounding behavior, not an adversarial security gauntlet.
The current repository does not claim production security monitoring or incident-response evidence.

adversarial.taxonomy: No dedicated agentic-security gauntlet published yet

residualRisks: The 35-case product evaluation is not counted as adversarial security evidence.
Cross-tenant access, evidence poisoning, indirect prompt injection and data-exfiltration attacks need dedicated regression cases.
Production multi-tenant isolation, supply-chain integrity and security monitoring remain unproven.
Qualified human review remains required before any external legal action.
